Definition: The item that receives keyboard input right now. Only one item has the focus at a time.
Able to receive the focus. Buttons and text fields are focusable; pictures are not, unless you make them focusable.
The order in which Tab moves the focus from item to item. Shift+Tab moves through it backwards.
The focus order a form works out for you, from the first control on a page to the last.
What shows which item has the focus, such as a highlight or an outline.
An object that is told whenever an item gains or loses the focus.
Software that reads the screen aloud, or shows it on a braille display, for people who are blind or have low vision.
